title: Of The Human Soul
author: Timothy Michael DiVito
text:
We taste of death
but once,

yet I shall surely taste
of your love

for these eternal days
through the

gray in the blackest
of death`s

touch. Our kiss shall
truly shine

like the intimate fires of
all that

is romance`s passion.
Ghosts

we are certainly not, but
flesh and

blood, carnal lovers
out of

the shadows into the
faithful light

of a brand new horizon,
embracing

with an intimate kiss
from our

deepest human soul, where
desire lives.

Far away from the onyx
ancient abyss,

where we once both lived
in despair. . . .
